## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested enhancement.

## Frontline Healthcare Context
How does this improvement help ASHAs, ANMs, or community health workers in low-connectivity rural settings?

## Proposed Implementation / UI Behavior
Describe how the feature should behave and how it integrates into existing screens (Ask, Beneficiaries, Planner, Dashboard).
*Note: UI must maintain strict text-only formatting with zero emojis/icons.*

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.
